items.title: How do underwater tunnels not flood?
items.summary: Britain and France dug toward each other under the sea and met only 36 cm apart. The Channel Tunnel has about 37.9 km under the sea and sits roughly 45 m below the seabed on average, cut through chalk marl. The main rail tunnel machines on the French side weighed about 1,100 tonnes. Crews dug from both coasts and the service tunnel bores met on December 1, 1990. Idea: Cleo Abram. Sources: Channel Tunnel (Wikipedia), Robbins TBM project page, Institution of Civil Engineers (the 358 mm offset at the meeting point). The 3D cross-section is a diagram: the machines, route and meeting point are illustrative. Sound effects: Storyblocks. Would you ride it? Yes or no.

items.summary: Release: llm 0.37.3 A bug fix release for LLM , mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software. Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1 , which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code . Short version: in SQLite 3.54.0 the following SQL: select json_object('a', (select json_array(1))) Returns this: {"a":[1]} But in 3.54.1 the same query returns this: {"a":"[1]"} According to D. Richard Hipp : That was a bug fix. Per the documentation, (SELECT json_array(...)) returns SQL text, not JSON. Hence the 3.54.1 behavior is correct and 3.54.0 was a bug. The wor...

items.title: datasette-apps 0.4a0
items.summary: Release: datasette-apps 0.4a0 Datasette Apps are sandboxed HTML and JavaScript applications that live inside Datasette - think Claude Artifacts, but these ones can run SQL queries against your data. 0.4a0 adds support for linking: you can link to an app with #fragments in the URL and the app can see and use those, plus supported URL schemes are reported back to Datasette Agent so it can help write apps that link to each other. This means you can have e.g. an app that shows details about a specific record, and a completely separate app that searches those records and links to their representati...

Most notably, it now adds an agent prompt directly to the Datasette homepage, with support for hash-mentions of tables and queries: Tags: datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai

items.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
items.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: wget https://datasette.io/content.db uvx --with datasette-agent datasette \ --root --secret 1 \ -s plugins.datasette-llm.de...

items.title: datasette-vega 0.7
items.summary: Release: datasette-vega 0.7 A new release of Datasette's longest untouched plugin, for rendering charts (using Vega-Lite ) against data in a table or custom query. The last release was in July 2018! I finally bumped it for compatibility with the latest Datasette alphas, plus some cosmetic tweaks to make it work better with Datasette Lite . (Datasette Lite just gained the ability to run JavaScript plugins like this! I'll write more about that soon.) Since it works with Datasette Lite, the live demo in the README now links to this demo on Datasette Lite . Tags: datasette , datasette-lite

items.title: Lợi ích bảo mật của Edge AI
items.summary: [English below] Theo ông David McQuarrie, công nghệ AI tích hợp trực tiếp trên thiết bị (AI at the Edge) sẽ giúp giải quyết triệt để sự nghi ngại của doanh nghiệp trong việc mở cửa cho AI. Khi toàn bộ quá trình tính toán chỉ diễn ra giữa con chip NPU và màn tính người dùng, sự bảo mật sẽ được đảm bảo tuyệt đối về mặt kỹ thuật. Xem phiên bản đầy đủ tập 416 Vietnam Innovators (Tiếng Anh) trên các kênh Youtube, Spotify & Apple Podcasts của Vietnam Innovators Digest để lắng nghe trọn vẹn chia sẻ từ ông David McQuarrie - Chủ tịch Điều hành Thương mại HP toàn cầu. - According to Mr. David McQuarrie, Edge AI fundamentally eliminates enterprise hesitation around adoption. Because workloads run entirely between the on-device NPU and the user's display, data privacy and security are guaranteed at the hardware level.
